items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And I played a date with Mal Hallett's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, at the Palace Theatre. And he said... I told him, "Boy I got this wire from the union that says if I don't go sign up with Glaser, then I can't work. They will tear up my card."
